[USER] Asked for further detailed explanations of the API permission granting process with examples and URL links to setting pages.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Detailed steps for requesting API permissions: Provide client ID, navigate to SharePoint Admin Center, request API access, and approve the request.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Detailed steps for granting API permissions manually: Navigate to API management page, search for Azure AD application, select it, and grant necessary permissions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that steps may vary based on the specific version of SharePoint and Azure AD instance.  
[USER] Inquired if there is a way for the Azure AD application owner to send a request or authorization link for the SharePoint owner/admin to easily authorize API permissions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained that there isn't a straightforward way to send a request or authorization link for API permissions; typically, the process is manual.  
[USER] Requested a custom solution using C#.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a high-level overview of creating a custom solution using C# to automate granting API permissions, including creating an Azure AD application, implementing a web API, and sending requests.  
[USER] Asked for further explanation of how the Global Admin approves the request for API access.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Detailed the steps for the Global Admin to approve the API permission request: access the API management page, view the request, approve it, confirm the permission, and verify it in the permissions list.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that specific steps may vary depending on the version of SharePoint and advised referring to SharePoint documentation for detailed information.
